context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 294 RMS Pro Suite tests completed. All 32 backend API tests passed. Tested endpoints: (1) GET /api/rms-pro/revpag/{property_id}?days=N - Returns revpag, revpar, adr, occupancy_pct, avg_party_size. Test property aldgate-flats returns RevPAG=£6.2, RevPAR=£12.4, ADR=£68.18. (2) GET /api/rms-pro/quality-score/{property_id} - Returns quality_score (0-100), recommended_rate_uplift_pct, 5 factors array (Review Score, Amenities, Photo Quality, Response Speed, Cleaning Quality). Test property returns quality_score=33.3, uplift=+5%. (3) GET /api/rms-pro/forecast-accuracy/{property_id}?days=N - Returns occupancy_accuracy_pct, revenue_accuracy_pct, samples, scored_samples from forecast_snapshots collection. Test property returns occ_accuracy=89%, rev_accuracy=18.6%, 411 samples, 154 scored. (4) POST /api/rms-pro/group-pricing-quote - Displacement analysis + AI rate recommendation. Returns decision (ACCEPT/DECLINE/NEGOTIATE), recommended_rate_per_night, total_displacement_cost, per_day array. (5) GET/POST /api/rms-pro/autopilot/config - Toggle autopilot mode, configure schedule_hour_utc, min_gap_pct, days_ahead, min_uplift_to_apply_pct. (6) GET /api/rms-pro/autopilot/history - Returns past autopilot runs. RBAC: All 7 endpoints correctly return 403 for receptionist role. Frontend: RmsProSuitePanel renders correctly with 4 KPI cards (RevPAG, Quality Score, Forecast Accuracy, Autopilot toggle), Group Pricing CTA button opens GroupPricingModal, form submission works, decision badge displays correctly (PAZARLIK/NEGOTIATE shown), Autopilot toggle updates config and shows toast notification. Existing Market Robot endpoints (competitor-pulse, fleet-pulse, close-gap, ai-fleet-optimize, gap-history) all still working - no regression.
